test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a characteristic of fibres in relation to plant anatomy?

options.text: Responsible for conduction and also mechanical support

solution:
The correct answer is __**Possess only pitted thickenings.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Plant fibres are elongated, most commonly sclerenchyma supportive plant cells with thick cellulose walls with a well-organized structure.
 
• Cellulose natural fibres are characterised by a fibrillar structure in which the crystalline arranged parts of cellulose I form a periodic array with amorphous cellulose molecules.
